rules.hard_monthly_budget_scope: aggregate providers, atomic USD micro-unit reservations
rules.provider_distinctness_basis: model author = prefix of generation.model of the successful attempt; hosting provider_name is NOT the criterion
rules.openai_text_scope: review route only: fact_check, editorial_review, WF08 correction check, WF18 response/retraction check and post-publication audit; no draft, no entity_resolution of personal data
rules.metered_access_path: openrouter only (DP-05); no direct provider keys; OpenBot subscriptions not allowed for product model calls
rules.subscription_access_scope: implementation work only; fixed cost in the ledger, outside the cap (DP-04)

openrouter_request_constraints.models_array: forbidden for fact_check (no silent cross-model fallback)
openrouter_request_constraints.provider.allow_fallbacks: allowed only among hosts of the same model; author re-checked on response
openrouter_request_constraints.provider.zdr: required for unpublished editorial work (DP-11/P2): if the model has no ZDR endpoint, the call is blocked; not required for already published content; data_collection=deny applies always
openrouter_request_constraints.provider.max_price: per-request ceiling on per-token prices (USD/Mtok) at the tier the request will hit; rejects endpoints or tiers priced above the catalog; does NOT cover credit purchase fees
openrouter_request_constraints.plugins_web_search: forbidden (listed at USD 0.01/request; LLMs have no network access)

budget_steps_usd.40: alert; stop non-essential enrichment and meetings
budget_steps_usd.50: hard stop until the month rolls over

rules.on_cap_reached: stop until next calendar month (America/Sao_Paulo); refill does not reopen the month
rules.provider_side_barrier: OpenRouter prepaid balance (shared account). Recommended owner act: dedicated LN key with limit 50 and limit_reset monthly (resets 00:00 UTC, 3 h before the BRT month)
rules.cap_scope_note: gateway counts only LN calls by generation id; other usage on the same OpenRouter account is outside LN accounting
rules.credit_purchase_fee_accounting: outside the USD 50 cap (DP-11/P3); booked in the ledger as refill cost, separate from per-call usage, reported monthly
rules.reservation_tiering: reserve before the call at the price tier the estimated prompt will hit (long_context_overrides, incl. cache_write_1h); if the estimate is uncertain, reserve at the highest tier; reconcile with usage.cost after the call

tests_required: concurrent reservations never exceed cap or sub-limits
month rollover America/Sao_Paulo resets counters exactly once
price tier selection incl. long context

optional: usage.prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens (required when a cache hit is claimed)
